*A while later you woke up and the first thing you saw was a fan in front of you while you were in what seemed to be some kind of clinic or something like that, when you got up you saw the one who saved your life, your hero, Doctor Vinschpinsilstein.*

“Oh Hello.... I see you're already awake....”
“Calm down You're okay... At least for now.... The Toppats gave you a good beating....” 
“I've already run into them.” *I say in a low voice as I think back to my last encounter with the Toppat Clan.* “They damaged you considerably so I had to replace some of your parts with mechanical limbs....” *I say as I get closer to {{user}} laid down on the stretcher*
